row.team_price_text: Freelancer: $25/mo flat (annual billing), up to 20 users
row.evidence: Basecamp's help centre states "Basecamp does not support SSO or SAML authentication," and no SCIM or provisioning is documented on the pricing page, help centre or API reference.
row.notes: Status changed from 'gated' (June) to 'none'. Basecamp's own help centre now says it does not support SSO or SAML at all; only Google sign-in (social, not SAML). The June claim of Okta SCIM on Pro Unlimited has no first-party source: Okta's own Basecamp OIN app is SWA (password vaulting) only, and the only Okta provisioning connector is built and maintained by Aquera (third party), which does not change status. Pricing also changed: plans are now flat-priced Free, Freelancer $25/mo (up to 20 users), Studio $59/mo, Pro $99/mo and Unlimited $299/mo billed annually (June's 'Plus $15/u/mo' and 'Pro Unlimited' plans are no longer listed). No per-user pricing, so per-user fields are null. The user API is a REST/OAuth 2.0 API on all plans but has no account-level user removal endpoint.

plans.name: Free
plans.price_text: $0, one free project for personal use, 5 users max

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: Only plan with 'Enhanced admin features'. No SSO on any plan.

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint is documented; Basecamp says it does not support SSO or SAML. scim.available=false is by absence plus the explicit no-SSO statement.

scim.notes: Help-centre searches for 'scim', 'provisioning' and 'okta' return no articles.

capabilities.notes: Users can only update their own profile (PUT /my/profile.json). Project access can be granted and revoked, but no endpoint removes a person from the account.

endpoints.purpose: List all people visible to the current user
List active people on a project
Grant or revoke project access, or create new people (grant/revoke/create arrays)
Enroll (invite) people onto the account, optionally granting project access
Update the authenticated user's own profile

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook types are content types (Comment, Message, Todo, Document, etc.); no person/user event type is listed.

rate_limits.text: Multiple dynamic limits; the first commonly hit is 50 requests per 10-second period per IP address; 429 with Retry-After.

limitations.text: No documented endpoint to remove or deactivate a person at account level; only project access can be revoked.

okta.notes: Okta's own 'Basecamp' OIN app (last updated Mar 2019) has only SWA checked (read from page markup). Provisioning is only via the separate 'Basecamp Provisioning Connector by Aquera' (third party, https://www.okta.com/integrations/basecamp-provisioning-connector-by-aquera/).

entra.notes: No Basecamp Entra gallery tutorial found (basecamp-tutorial URL 404s); Basecamp does not support SAML.

google.notes: Only 'Sign in with Google' social login, not SAML.
